collocations: stipulate that... / as stipulated in the contract
tip: 多益聽力與閱讀常考商業合約條款，後面常接子句或與 'specify'、'state' 替換。
sentence: The contract stipulates that all deliveries must be made within 30 days.
sentenceZh: 合約規定所有交貨必須在 30 天內完成。

tip: 多益最愛考的法務單字之一！動詞名詞同形，常考 'breach of contract'（違約）。
sentence: Failing to meet the deadline will be considered a breach of contract.
sentenceZh: 未能在期限前完成將被視為違約。

collocations: fall under the jurisdiction of / local jurisdiction
tip: 多益高階合約題常考，用來規範若發生訴訟要在哪個國家或地區審理。
sentence: Any legal disputes arising from this contract will be under the jurisdiction of Taipei courts.
sentenceZh: 因本合約引發的任何法律爭議將歸台北法院管轄。

tip: 常指規模較大或具有冒險精神的商業企業，多益商業閱讀中常見。
sentence: The small startup has grown into a successful global enterprise.
sentenceZh: 這家小型新創公司已經成長為一家成功的全球企業。

tip: 常考固定片語 'joint venture'（合資企業 / 聯合事業）。
sentence: The two tech giants entered into a joint venture to develop new AI software.
sentenceZh: 這兩家科技巨頭合資成立了一家公司來開發新的人工智慧軟體。

tip: 多益財經與企業新聞題組常客，動詞為 merge（合併）。
sentence: The proposed merger between the two banks will be finalized next month.
sentenceZh: 這兩家銀行擬議中的合併案將於下個月底定。

tip: 動詞為 allocate（分配、撥出）。多益測驗常考預算分配與經費運用。
sentence: The committee approved the budget allocation for the marketing department.
sentenceZh: 委員會批准了行銷部門的預算分配。

tip: 多益商業常考 'fiscal year'（會計年度 / 財政年度），注意與 'financial' 的區別。
sentence: Our company's fiscal year ends on December 31st.
sentenceZh: 我們公司的會計年度於 12 月 31 日結束。

tip: 相反詞為 surplus（盈餘、順差），多益經濟與財務題組常同時出現。
sentence: The government is trying to reduce the national trade deficit.
sentenceZh: 政府正試圖減少國家貿易赤字。

tip: 多益求職與面試情境必考字，常與 'applicant'（申請人）替換。
sentence: We interviewed several strong candidates for the position of project manager.
sentenceZh: 我們為專案經理一職面試了几位優秀的應徵者。

tip: 名詞為 recruitment（招募），多益人資廣告常出現 'now recruiting'。
sentence: The firm plans to recruit top talent from local universities.
sentenceZh: 該公司計畫從當地大學招募頂尖人才。

tip: 動詞為 appraise（評估、評價）。多益職場常考 'performance appraisal'（績效考核）。
sentence: Annual performance appraisals will take place at the end of this quarter.
sentenceZh: 年度績效考核將在本季末舉行。

tip: 常搭配介系詞 with，多益 IT 軟硬體採購與說明書題組必考。
sentence: Make sure the new software is compatible with your operating system.
sentenceZh: 請確保新軟體與您的作業系統相容。

collocations: system upgrade / upgrade to a higher version
tip: 多益辦公室設備更新與電腦系統維護公告常見用語。
sentence: IT department will perform a network system upgrade this weekend.
sentenceZh: 資訊部門將於本週末進行網路系統升級。

tip: 名詞為 automation（自動化），形容詞為 automated（自動化的）。
sentence: The factory decided to automate its assembly line to increase efficiency.
sentenceZh: 工廠決定將其裝配線自動化以提高效率。

tip: 多益旅遊及出差規劃題組高頻字，常出現在確認信或電子郵件中。
sentence: I have emailed you the detailed travel itinerary for your upcoming business trip.
sentenceZh: 我已經將您即將到來的出差詳細行程表寄到您的信箱了。

tip: 雖然常用複數形式 accommodations，但單數也常見。多益差旅報銷常客。
sentence: The company will cover all travel and accommodation expenses for the conference.
sentenceZh: 公司將負擔此次會議的所有差旅與住宿費用。

tip: 動詞為 reimburse（核銷、補償）。員工出差回來後提交 'reimbursement form'。
sentence: Please submit your receipts for travel expense reimbursement by Friday.
sentenceZh: 請於周五前提交您的差旅費收據以進行報銷。

tip: 相反詞為 retail（零售），多益商業採購與供應鏈題組常考。
sentence: The company buys office supplies in bulk at wholesale prices.
sentenceZh: 該公司以批發價大量購買辦公用品。

collocations: approved vendor / reliable vendor / third-party vendor
tip: 多益採購部門（Purchasing Department）與合約管理常見的重要角色。
sentence: We need to evaluate three new potential vendors before signing the contract.
sentenceZh: 在簽署合約之前，我們需要評估三個新的潛在供應商。

collocations: take inventory / inventory control / out of stock
tip: 多益倉儲物流與零售題組必考，常與 'stock' 替換。
sentence: The warehouse will be closed next Monday for annual inventory check.
sentenceZh: 倉庫將於下周一關閉以進行年度庫存盤點。

collocations: customer inquiry / general inquiry / make an inquiry
tip: 動詞為 inquire（詢問）。多益客服中心（Call Center）信件常見標題。
sentence: Our customer service team handles dozens of inquiries every day.
sentenceZh: 我們的客戶服務團隊每天處理數十起客戶查詢。

collocations: under warranty / extended warranty / manufacturer warranty
tip: 多益消費電子產品與消費糾紛題組必考，注意與 guarantee 的區別。
sentence: The laptop comes with a two-year manufacturer warranty.
sentenceZh: 這台筆記型電腦附帶兩年原廠保固。

tip: 動詞為 compensate（補償）。在多益中可指工作薪資或損害賠償金。
sentence: The airline offered travel vouchers as compensation for the delayed flight.
sentenceZh: 航空公司提供旅遊禮券作為班機延誤的補償。

collocations: promote a new product / be promoted to manager
tip: 多益多義字！在行銷情境解作「促銷/推廣」，在人資情境解作「升職」。
sentence: The advertising agency launched a new campaign to promote the brand.
sentenceZh: 廣告公司發起了一項新活動來宣傳該品牌。

tip: 動詞為 endorse（背書、贊同）。多益廣告行銷題組常考名人代言效益。
sentence: Sales increased dramatically after the famous actor signed the endorsement deal.
sentenceZh: 在這位知名演員簽署代言合約後，銷售額大幅成長。

zh: 人口統計資料、客群族群
tip: 多益市場調查與廣告投放策略題組高頻字，指特定年齡或收入的消費族群。
sentence: The new product is specifically designed for the younger demographic.
sentenceZh: 這項新產品是專門為年輕客群設計的。

tip: 多益工廠製造題組必考 'assembly line'（裝配線 / 生產線）。
sentence: Workers on the assembly line ensure that every product meets quality standards.
sentenceZh: 生產線上的工人確保每項產品都符合品質標準。

tip: 動詞為 inspect（檢查、審視）。多益海關、工廠與安檢題組常見。
sentence: All items must undergo strict quality inspection before packaging.
sentenceZh: 所有商品在包裝前都必須經過嚴格的品質檢驗。

collocations: full capacity / production capacity / seating capacity
tip: 多益常考 'at full capacity'（全滿/全力運轉）或 'production capacity'（產能）。
sentence: The factory is currently operating at maximum production capacity.
sentenceZh: 該工廠目前正以最大產能運作。

collocations: sign a lease / lease agreement / commercial lease
tip: 多益商辦租賃合約題組必考，常與 'rent'（租金/租用）搭配考察。
sentence: Our office building lease expires at the end of next month.
sentenceZh: 我們辦公大樓的租約将在下月底到期。

tip: 房東為 landlord，多益物業管理與租賃廣告常見字彙。
sentence: The landlord is responsible for major repairs, but tenants must keep the place clean.
sentenceZh: 房東負責大修繕，但房客必須保持地方整潔。

tip: 動詞為 maintain（維持、保養）。多益大樓管理與設備維修公告常客。
sentence: The elevator will be out of service today for scheduled maintenance.
sentenceZh: 電梯今天將因例行維修而暫停使用。

tip: 動詞為 reserve（預訂）。多益聽力 Part 2/3 常考餐廳或飯店預約情境。
sentence: I would like to make a table reservation for four people at 7 PM.
sentenceZh: 我想預訂晚上 7 點四人座的位子。

tip: 動詞為 cater（迎合、提供伙食）。多益公司年會或研討會籌辦常見。
sentence: We hired a local catering company for the corporate annual dinner.
sentenceZh: 我們為公司年度晚宴聘請了一家當地的外燴公司。

tip: 多益旅遊、飯店與觀光產業相關測驗的高頻字彙。
sentence: She has over ten years of management experience in the hospitality industry.
sentenceZh: 她在餐旅業擁有十多年的管理經驗。

tip: 形容詞為 precautionary（預防的）。多益工廠安全與防疫公告常考。
sentence: Workers must wear helmets and gloves as a safety precaution.
sentenceZh: 作為安全預防措施，工人的配戴安全帽與手套。

collocations: fire hazard / safety hazard / potential hazard
tip: 形容詞為 hazardous（有害的、危險的，如 hazardous waste 危害廢棄物）。
sentence: Loose cables on the floor can create a serious safety hazard for employees.
sentenceZh: 地板上鬆動的電纜可能會對員工構成嚴重的安全危害。

collocations: safety regulations / government regulations / comply with regulations
tip: 動詞為 regulate（管制、調節）。多益法務與合規（compliance）題組必考核心。
sentence: All businesses must strictly follow environmental regulations.
sentenceZh: 所有企業都必須嚴格遵守環保法規。
